content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Kanpur Postdoctoral Fellow Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 10-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT Kanpur Postdoctoral Fellow Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Postdoctoral Fellow position at IIT Kanpur is 10 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches them before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Postdoctoral Fellow positions?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Postdoctoral Fellow posts under the IIT Kanpur Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for these positions?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Postdoctoral Fellow positions at IIT Kanpur is email. Candidates need to send their detailed application to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required qualification for the Postdoctoral Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a PhD in Power electronics with at least one research paper published as the lead author in a peer-reviewed SCI journal.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Postdoctoral Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Postdoctoral Fellow position will receive a salary of Rs 80,000 per month plus HRA, as per ANRF norms.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for IIT Kanpur Postdoctoral Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for the IIT Kanpur Postdoctoral Fellow Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Postdoctoral Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting applicants based on their applications, followed by an interview for the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the job location for the Postdoctoral Fellow position?
faq.answer: The job location for the Postdoctoral Fellow position is Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh, at the Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for the IIT Kanpur Postdoctoral Fellow Recruitment is P.Rect./R&D/2026/167.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should be included in the application email?
faq.answer: The application should include a detailed resume with qualifications and experience, along with two references of people the candidate has worked with but are not related.
